name: The Reid household at 2013 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_reid_william_h

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2013 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2013 Mr. & Mrs. William H. Reid.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2013, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two live-in staff and one child it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: William H. Reid
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Wm. H. Reid here as head, born April 1845, in Ohio, married, president (company) (ED 40, sheet 12A, line 46, leaf n816).

persons.name: Mrs. William H. Reid
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Caroline Reid here as wife, born May 1862, in Connecticut, married (ED 40, sheet 12A, line 47, leaf n816).

persons.name: Roy Williams

born.note: The census gives 1886, age 14 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "At school" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as grandson? (at school); born 1886, in Arkansas. The 1904 Blue Book names no children, so a child at home in 1900 is placed here in 1904 by inference. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.

persons.name: Jane Riley

born.note: The census gives July 1874, age 25 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Parlor maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (parlor maid); born July 1874, in Ireland, came to the United States in 1895, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
